title: Final Prices With a Discount

concept.title: The same waiting stack, with a different rule
body: A shop gives, for the item at position `i`, a discount equal to the price of the **first item to its right that is not more expensive** (`price[j] <= price[i]`). The answer for `i` is `price[i] - price[j]`; if there is no such item, there is no discount.

This is the "next greater element" idea with the comparison turned around. Keep a stack of the indexes that have not received their discount yet. A new price `p` is the discount for every waiting item whose price is **at least** `p`: pop them and subtract.

body.code:
result = prices[:]
stack = []
for i, p in enumerate(prices):
    while stack and prices[stack[-1]] >= p:
        j = stack.pop()
        result[j] = prices[j] - p
    stack.append(i)

body: The prices on the stack are always increasing from the bottom to the top, which is why it is called a monotonic stack.

statement: Given the prices of `n` items in a row, the final price of item `i` is its price minus the price of the first item to its right that costs less than or the same as item `i` (`price[j] <= price[i]` with `j > i`). If there is no such item, the final price is the original price. Print all final prices.
inputFormat: The second line has the `n` prices.
outputFormat: Print the `n` final prices separated by spaces.
hints: The discount comes from the first item to the right that is not more expensive.
Keep a stack of indexes whose discount is still unknown.
A new price settles all waiting items that cost at least as much.

explanation: The stack holds the items still waiting for a discount. A new price gives the discount to every waiting item that is at least as expensive, which is exactly the "first not more expensive item to the right".

code.python:
import sys
input = sys.stdin.readline

n = int(input())
p = list(map(int, input().split()))

res = p[:]
stack = []
for i in range(n):
    while stack and p[stack[-1]] >= p[i]:
        j = stack.pop()
        res[j] = p[j] - p[i]
    stack.append(i)
print(*res)
